visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white cat sits on a white table with its back to the camera, licking its fur in a bright, well-lit studio environment. In the background, a computer monitor displays a software interface. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows on the white surface. (2) Extreme close-up shots highlight the texture of multicolored tortoiseshell fur and orange fur, showing distinct layered patterns. A human hand enters to stroke the fur of a cat, pulling back the top layer to reveal the dense white undercoat and skin beneath. (3) The scene shifts through various shots of different cats, including a pure white cat looking up, a tortoiseshell cat staring at the camera, and a black-and-white cat on a grey chair. The cats are mostly stationary, with the focus remaining on their physical appearance and fur texture. (4) An orange cat is shown sitting on a wooden floor next to a pair of slippers before transitioning to a close-up of the same cat eating a light yellow powder from a saucer. A product box with 'Lady Flavor' branding and a cheese graphic is prominently displayed next to the dish.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 好味小姐 LADY FLAVOR. [Subtitle]: 貓咪出現蒜瓣毛代表他很幸福？(2) [Subtitle]: 貓咪的毛髮上. (3) [Subtitle]: 一層一層的. (4) [Subtitle]: 一樣的分層. (5) [Subtitle]: 到底是貓咪好幸福還是貓咪生病了呢？ (6) [Subtitle]: 這裡要先說明一下貓毛的形成. (7) [Subtitle]: 貓咪的毛髮是由表面粗硬的主毛和底層細軟的副毛所組成的. (8) [Subtitle]: 副毛集結後就會形成一層底絨. (9) [Subtitle]: 所以貓咪們要出現蒜瓣毛表示底絨的副毛要夠厚！ (10) [Subtitle]: 主毛也要密集蓬鬆柔軟還要有光澤. (11) [Subtitle]: 這樣子就是幸福又健康的蒜瓣毛髮哦！ (12) [Subtitle]: 但是也有可能出現假蒜瓣毛！ (13) [Subtitle]: 就像是貓咪過胖的時候皮膚會被撐開. (14) [Subtitle]: 毛髮的層次感也會突然變得突出. (15) [Subtitle]: 或者當貓咪的皮脂分泌過多缺乏清潔的時候. (16) [Subtitle]: 毛髮變得油膩粗糙打結. (17) [Subtitle]: 也會出現類似蒜瓣毛的分層現象哦！ (18) [Subtitle]: 所以如果貓咪身上出現了蒜瓣毛. (19) [Subtitle]: 大家可以先觀察毛髮是否光亮不油膩柔軟不打結！ (20) [Subtitle]: 就可以確定這是不是幸福的蒜瓣毛了！ (21) [Subtitle]: 生活中呢注意不要讓貓咪過胖. (22) [Subtitle]: 並且讓貓咪吃的營養均衡定期梳毛. (23) [Subtitle]: 大家都可養出象徵幸福的蒜瓣毛哦！ (24) [Subtitle]: 這裡推薦一下我們的好味保養護膚魚Q粉. (25) [Subtitle]: 換毛季開始了. (26) [Subtitle]: 大家除了要定期幫他們排毛之外也可以幫貓咪補充Omega-3. (27) [Subtitle]: 讓貓咪長出亮麗蓬鬆的蒜瓣毛吧！ (28) [Subtitle]: 我是好味小姐養貓要知道那你知道了嗎？
